tasks.title: Implement ATS ScreeningOrchestrator — integrate GenericScreeningEngine to score job post requirements against candidates, emit screening results to ats_applications
tasks.summary: Implemented screenJobPost() in ScreeningOrchestrator. Uses GenericScreeningEngine to evaluate candidates against job post criteria matrix. Persists screening_score, screening_result, and screened_at to ats_applications. BDD test ats_can_screen_candidates_for_job_post passes (6 assertions).

tasks.title: Implement ATS CrawlerOrchestrator — connect CandidateSourceFactory to import candidates from JobVision/Talent APIs into ats_applications
tasks.summary: Implemented importCandidates() in CrawlerOrchestrator. Uses JobVisionCrawler.fetchCandidates() and CandidateSourceFactory (JobVisionSource) to parse and import candidates. Creates Candidate + Application records linked to job post. BDD tests ats_crawler_orchestrator_imports_candidates and ats_crawler_orchestrator_unsupported_source_throws pass.

tasks.title: Implement ATS ShortlistGenerator — use GenericScreeningEngine.generateShortlist to rank candidates and create ats_shortlists with ats_shortlist_items
tasks.summary: Implemented ShortlistGenerator service with generateShortlist(). Retrieves screened applications, uses GenericScreeningEngine.generateShortlist() with domain criteria, creates Shortlist + ShortlistItem records with rank and match_score. BDD tests ats_shortlist_generator_creates_shortlist and ats_shortlist_generator_empty_when_no_candidates pass.
